notes: The transport / balloon module. The spreadsheet's unnamed 'Free Port' rows and its Components entry refer to this, but the module itself is specified in the printed art and the rulebook, not in the sheet.
One Port (Aerodrome) card per player, printed as identical copies on the Vegetable front sheet. They are NOT shuffled into the Vegetable deck, so they are absent from cards.json.

The Aerodrome is the freight delivery destination that several Vegetable cards reference. Unlike an island delivery space, a balloon is MOVED rather than claimed, so it can be collected repeatedly. It is deliberately unrationed.
Moving a balloon IS the Deliver action, not a free action and not a card-only effect.
moveCost is the printed 'two crates, not equal' icon: two barn cards of two DIFFERENT suits.

THE MAGENTA BALLOON IS A HARVEST BALLOON (Dean, 02/09/2026, v31). It printed 'Gain GBP 4' and v31 deleted coins, so it needed a new reward rather than a smaller one. It is now 'Harvest any building, even if it is not full', which is the relaxed harvest that used to sit on the Wheat door - the one rider from the enhanced-door era worth keeping, re-homed onto the one card in the game with room for it. It has NO `amount`: 'even if it is not full' is a rule, not a size, so there is nothing here to sweep and the sky-dull arm can only dull three of the four balloons. ITS ID AND COLOUR ARE UNCHANGED ON PURPOSE. `balloonCoins` is now a misnomer and it stays a misnomer, because V19 The Sky Market scores 2 VP per balloon in your Aerodrome by COUNT and any rename would have to be chased through the card handler, the art and the reports for no gain. Read the id as a slot number.

handMoveCost is the ALTERNATIVE payment printed on Vegetable's Depots (V4 and V8, the rebuild of 2026-08-09): discard this many cards from your HAND instead. The base rule above is unchanged for everybody, including a Vegetable seat taking the plain Deliver action; nothing else in the game may use the hand route. No suit constraint: the differing-crops rule belongs to the barn payment, and is what makes the balloon the table's sink for odd cards. LOWERED 2 -> 1 on 2026-08-09, and the reason is worth keeping because it was an arithmetic error rather than a taste call: at 2 the printed route cost a GROW action plus 1 matching card into the Depot's stack plus 2 discards, which is THREE cards of the scarce resource against the base rule's TWO of the abundant one, so the route was a surcharge and the Vegetable seat correctly declined it (0.54 hand-paid flights a game against the 4.2 the same seat took by the ordinary Deliver action). At 1 a flight is two hand cards on a GROW, which leaves the Deliver action free for the island - the point of the privilege. Measured paired at n=1580: flights 0.54 -> 1.22, island deliveries 2.89 -> 3.20, win rate 14.8% -> 18.9%, visits per turn 0.62 -> 0.61 (the hand did NOT starve), game length flat. The dial back up is this number. RE-READ IT AFTER v31: the measurement was taken with a hand limit and a 2-see-1-keep Draw, and v31 has neither, so hand cards are cheaper now than the arm that set this number saw them.

Setup: all four balloons start unowned beside the play area (the centre) - no per-seat parking and no draft (ticket 06 ruling J). The reference implementation and rulebook v1 park one per seat instead; ruling J explicitly supersedes that, and the divergence is flagged to the rulings audit (ticket 07). No reward is collected at setup - rewards pay only on arrival by a move.
Legal source for a move is a NEIGHBOUR's Port or the unowned central Aerodrome. Never your own Port.

A balloon move is a Deliver but is NOT a 'Deliver to the island'. Cards gate themselves by printed phrase, which is why the ability dispatcher needs both onDeliver and onDeliverIsland trigger keys. A card printing the gated form cannot re-trigger itself off a balloon move, so no recursion guard is needed. IT ALSO NEVER COUNTS TOWARD THE END TRIGGER, which is a delivery count on the island alone.

⭐ `reward.suit` ON EVERY BALLOON (12/09/2026), and it is INERT at the shipped reward types: only 'plainAction' reads it. It is filled in on all four because the mapping it records is already three-quarters true of the shipped module - balloonDraw is Orchard's hex #ca5744 and pays Draw, balloonBuild is Dairy's #f4d68d and pays Build, balloonSow is Apiary's #e7963b - and because a dead knob template fails the data test. ⚠️ balloonCoins IS THE ODD ONE: it pays Harvest, which is WHEAT's action, while wearing magenta #c15c90, a colour no suit has. So it is recorded as 'wheat' here and its hex is the one thing Dean's four-balloon scheme has to move. ⛔ THERE IS NO VEGETABLE BALLOON AND THERE MUST NOT BE: a flight IS the Deliver action, so a balloon paying Deliver self-cancels (L2, the law that killed VISIT-as-a-main-action in v13). Deliver is the one core action the module never pays, and Vegetable's claim on the module is that its cards make flights CHEAPER and MORE FREQUENT, not that it owns a balloon.

⭐ RULED BY DEAN, 12/09/2026. THE FOUR BALLOONS PAY THE PLAIN BASE ACTION OF THEIR COLOUR and a flight costs ONE barn card of ANY crop, taken as your Deliver action, with the balloon moving to your Aerodrome. ⭐ THE REASON IS THE PARITY TRAP, MEASURED: a crate is 2 cards of ONE crop, all or nothing, so 88.8% of barn-holding decisions cannot afford any open tile and 84% of those are one or two cards short. A ONE-CARD DELIVERY IS THE FIRST RULE IN THIS GAME THAT MAKES A SINGLE ODD BARN CARD WORTH ANYTHING - Dean's words, it 'emulates the coin tap'. ⭐ AND IT DELETES THE MODULE'S REFERENCE CARD: the rewards are no longer four bespoke powers but the SAME colour-to-action mapping a player already learns for the five central Notice Boards, routed through the same `performDoorAction`. ⛔ THERE IS NO VEGETABLE BALLOON AND THERE MUST NOT BE: a flight IS the Deliver action, so a Deliver balloon self-cancels (L2). The four balloons are the four actions that are NOT Deliver, which makes Deliver the key that buys every other verb - and that is Vegetable's claim on the module. ⚠️ balloonCoins IS RECOLOURED from magenta #c15c90 to WHEAT #e2c488: it already paid Harvest, which is wheat's action, in a colour no suit had. Its ID stays a misnomer on purpose (V19 counts balloons by id). ⚠️ AND V4/V8's HAND-PAID FLIGHT IS NOW DEAD BY ARITHMETIC: handMoveCost is 1 and the barn cost is also 1, so the suit's one exclusive route costs a scarce hand card where anybody may spend a dead barn card. That is a CARD question this ruling does not answer and it is the first thing to re-price.

⚠️ `reward.amount` IS KEPT ON THE THREE BALLOONS THAT HAD ONE, AND IS NOW INERT: 'plainAction' never reads it. It stays for two concrete reasons rather than tidiness. (1) The knob template aerodrome.balloons.{}.reward.amount is registered, and a knob whose path the data no longer has is an OverlayError, so deleting it would break every committed overlay that pins it - including the three historical controls, which MUST pin it to reproduce their own games. (2) It is what an arm restores when it sets the type back. ⛔ IT ALSO MEANS overlays/sky-dull-v1 and sky-rich-v1 ARE NOW NO-OPS: they sweep an amount the shipped reward type ignores. They are kept because they still mean something under a type-restoring arm, but a run of either against this base measures NOTHING and must not be quoted as a reward sweep.
unresolved: The magenta balloon's new reward has never been priced against the other three. Draw 4, Build at a discount of 4 and Sow 4 are all quantities; 'harvest any building, even if it is not full' is a permission, and in a v31 turn that already buys a free Harvest through the Wheat door it may be either the strongest of the four or the dullest. It is the one balloon overlays/sky-dull-v1.overlay.json cannot turn down.
